mobileWarning.title: For a Better Experience
mobileWarning.body: Test Studio is optimized for <1>desktop</1> or <3>tablet</3> screens for detailed work like PDF cropping and test layout.
mobileWarning.hint: On a larger screen you'll be able to use every feature far more efficiently.

alerts.poolLimit: A pool can hold at most {{max}} questions. You currently have {{current}}{{suffix}}
alerts.poolLimitSuffixMulti: and you're trying to add {{adding}} more.
alerts.exportThreshold: You've reached {{threshold}} questions. You can keep adding, but a single test can include at most {{threshold}} questions when downloaded.
alerts.perfThreshold: Your pool has more than {{threshold}} questions. A very large pool may slow your device down.
alerts.previewLimit: Your pool has {{count}} questions, but a single test can include at most {{max}}. Please use Auto-Select to pick at most {{max}} questions, or reduce the pool size.

workflow.postCropMessage: Once you've organized your questions, open the Layout Desk to prepare your sheet.
workflow.idleMessage: Open the Layout Desk to organize and export your test.

topbar.fullscreenUnsupported: This browser does not support fullscreen for web pages. In Safari, use Share > Add to Home Screen to run Test Studio like a fullscreen app.

comingSoon.optikBody: The module that scans printed answer sheets with your phone and instantly calculates scores is currently being tested with a limited group. It will be available to everyone very soon.
comingSoon.onlineBody: A module for sending online tests to students via link and tracking results is in development. It will be available soon.

yaziliInfo.title: Under Development
yaziliInfo.body: The Written Module is still under development. If you want to prepare a written exam by cropping questions from PDFs, we recommend the written-exam workflow inside the <1>Test Module</1>.

userMenu.unsavedSignOut: You have unsaved questions in the pool. Are you sure you want to log out?
